---
name: 3d-engineering
description: >-
  Engineer parametric mechanical parts and assemblies with the CAD3D platform. Use
  for product design, enclosures, supports, mechanisms, interfaces, fluid paths,
  build123d/OCP, STEP/STL, FDM/DFAM, and OrcaSlicer workflows. Do not use for
  unrelated software tasks or general 3D art.
---

# CAD3D product engineering

Use the existing global `cad3d` CLI; it runs the CAD engine (`build123d`/OCP) and,
optionally, the isolated OrcaSlicer manufacturing engine. Do not install CAD Python
packages on the host. Start with `cad3d --help` and `cad3d doctor` when needed.

## Workflow

For consequential products, proceed in gates: requirements → functional architecture
→ mechanical architecture → parametric geometry → system review → manufacturing.
Use `cad3d architecture init --level product` and edit `.cad3d/engineering.yaml`;
validate with `cad3d architecture validate`. Do not create functional solids before
the first three gates pass. Simple spacers/supports may use the lightweight project
level; match process depth to risk.

Model from explicit datums, units, interfaces and parameters. Map each component to a
function, positioning relation and retention method; explicitly declare intended free
parts. Validate geometry and assemblies using `cad3d build`, then run
`cad3d architecture validate --geometry`, `cad3d review`, and
`cad3d report --requirements`. Correct FAIL results and rerun the relevant checks.
PASS requires traceable evidence; declaration or a generated solid alone is not proof.
Treat WARNING and NOT_EVALUATED as unresolved review items. A CAD-valid assembly is
not thereby mechanically stable, printable, physically validated, or ready to release.

Generate technical views with `cad3d render --view engineering`: opaque isometric,
orthographic top/front/side, section, exploded, plus configured hidden-component and
critical-interface views. Review the actual images for occlusion and legibility.
Export with `cad3d export`. For FDM use the versioned printer/material/process
profiles and `cad3d slice --printer elegoo-cc2 --material petg`; inspect
`cad3d slice-report`. Slicing is an estimate, not printer compatibility or physical
validation. Never start a print or transmit a file to a printer.

## Load references by project class

- General product phases and gates: [product_engineering.md](references/product_engineering.md)
- Requirements, YAML contract, interfaces and evidence: [requirements_and_interfaces.md](references/requirements_and_interfaces.md)
- Assemblies, retention, fit and service: [mechanical_assemblies.md](references/mechanical_assemblies.md)
- FDM design and profiles: [dfam.md](references/dfam.md)
- Passive channels and fluid paths: [fluid_systems.md](references/fluid_systems.md)
- Adversarial/system review: [design_review.md](references/design_review.md)
- Professional view generation: [visual_validation.md](references/visual_validation.md)
- Commercial part envelopes: [commercial_components.md](references/commercial_components.md)
- Existing CAD checks: [assembly-validation.md](references/assembly-validation.md)
- OrcaSlicer engine and its limits: [orcaslicer-engine.md](references/orcaslicer-engine.md)

Choose relevant references; do not load every topic for a simple part. Keep requirement
implementation distinct from verification, engineering judgment distinct from automated
checks, and physical validation distinct from CAD/slicer evidence. For adversarial review,
use a fresh Codex context when available. A sequential checklist is not an independent
review; report that limitation explicitly.

# Product engineering workflow

Scale rigor to consequence. For a simple noncritical part, document its function, dimensions, printer envelope and fit assumptions; for assemblies and flow systems use all phase gates. A product contract lives at `.cad3d/engineering.yaml` and is validated by `cad3d architecture validate`.

1. Requirements: function, operating conditions, verified measurements vs assumptions, commercial items, acceptance, external interfaces, risks and unknowns.
2. Functional architecture: subsystems, input/output, physical flows, modes and failure modes. Demonstrate conceptual operation without CAD.
3. Mechanical architecture: datums, constraints, attachment/retention, fits, service access, disassembly sequence and print splits.
4. Modeling: only after phases 1–3 validate; parametric parts, placed assembly, interfaces and early views.
5. System review: requirements evidence, interfaces, retention, assembly/removal, access, channels, manufacturing and residual risks.
6. Fabrication: orient and assess, optional OrcaSlicer, export, prototype plan and dimensional inspection.

Critical FAIL or required NOT_EVALUATED blocks subsequent approval. Warnings need disposition. CAD B-rep validity, assembly validity, manufacturing assessment, slicing success, printer compatibility and physical validation are separate claims.
# Passive fluid systems

Model the functional architecture before solids: sources, sinks, chambers, passages, direction, operating modes, seals, overflow and blockage/failure cases. Each declared route maps to actual open geometry with inlet/outlet points, section/clearance and sampling resolution. Run `cad3d architecture validate --geometry` and inspect reported blocked sample and B-rep evidence.

A geometric centerline/open-path check establishes only that sampled points lie in void space. It does not establish watertight sealing, flow rate, pressure loss, priming, air removal, fouling resistance, CFD performance or physical leak safety. Keep those as explicit unevaluated verification items until measured or simulated with a suitable method.
# Requirements and interfaces

Edit the extensible YAML contract at `.cad3d/engineering.yaml`; see `templates/engineering.yaml`. Stable IDs connect requirements, subsystems, components, interfaces, dependencies, verification method, evidence and status. Evidence uses a project-relative JSON file and JSON Pointer; the validator reads it and fingerprints its value. A claimed implementation is not verification. PASS needs current, identifiable evidence; unknown evidence is NOT_EVALUATED.

Record measurement provenance and label every dimension `verified` or `assumption`. Never silently promote assumptions. Interfaces state participants, reference geometry, datum, intended relation, fit class and selected printer/material/calibration tolerance. Report unavailable geometry checks as NOT_EVALUATED. Use physical validation status separately.

# Demonstração genérica. Geometria nominal em milímetros.
box:
  length: 60.0
  width: 40.0
  height: 24.0
  wall: 2.0
  clearance: 0.30
printer:
  profile: bambu-a1
"""Caixa de calibração genérica, com corpo e tampa separados."""
from build123d import Align, Box, Locations, Mode, Pos


def build(params):
    p = params["box"]
    length, width, height = p["length"], p["width"], p["height"]
    wall, gap = p["wall"], p["clearance"]
    if min(length, width, height, wall) <= 0 or gap < 0:
        raise ValueError("Dimensões e parede precisam ser positivas; folga não pode ser negativa")
    if 2 * wall >= min(length, width) or wall >= height:
        raise ValueError("Parede incompatível com dimensões externas")
    body_outer = Box(length, width, height, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    cavity = Pos(0, 0, wall) * Box(length-2*wall, width-2*wall, height,
                                    align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    body = body_outer - cavity
    lid_h = max(2.0, wall)
    lid = Pos(0, 0, height + 5) * Box(length+2*gap, width+2*gap, lid_h,
                                      align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    return {"body": body, "lid": lid}

item.text: A arquitetura escolhida será um corpo de três câmaras em série, com defletores alternados e passagens baixas entre câmaras. A entrada e a saída ficam em bocais laterais opostos; uma tampa removível dá acesso a todo o interior. Como a vazão e o desnível disponível ainda não foram definidos, vou tratar a circulação como dependente de uma diferença de carga externa e não atribuir capacidade hidráulica. A redução de bolsões de ar será tratada por teto inclinado e pontos altos ventiláveis, a validar geometricamente e depois em protótipo.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
  cat <<'USAGE'
usage: cad3d {doctor|init <project>|build|validate|render|export|report|test|architecture|review|calibration|slicer|slice|slice-report} [options]

init creates a project template in a new or existing directory without replacing files.
architecture init|validate and review manage the product engineering contract and review.
CAD commands run in cad3d-engineering Docker. `slicer` and `slice` run the separate cad3d-orca container.
USAGE
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--help" || "${1:-}" == "-h" ]]; then
  usage
  exit 0
fi

# Resolve the symlink so the platform remains discoverable from ~/.local/bin.
SCRIPT_PATH="$(readlink -f -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
ROOT="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "$SCRIPT_PATH")/.." && pwd -P)"
COMPOSE_FILE="$ROOT/compose.yaml"
IMAGE="cad3d-engineering:1.4.0"

if [[ "${1:-}" == "init" && "${2:-}" =~ ^(-h|--help)$ ]]; then
  echo 'usage: cad3d init <project-directory>'
  exit 0
fi

if [[ "${1:-}" == "init" ]]; then
  shift
  [[ $# -eq 1 ]] || { echo 'ERROR: uso: cad3d init <project-directory>' >&2; exit 2; }
  template="$ROOT/templates/project"
  dest="$1"
  if [[ -e "$dest" && ! -d "$dest" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: destino não é um diretório: $dest" >&2
    exit 2
  fi
  mkdir -p -- "$dest"
  dest="$(cd -- "$dest" && pwd -P)"
  shopt -s dotglob nullglob
  entries=("$template"/*)
  shopt -u dotglob nullglob
  for entry in "${entries[@]}"; do
    name="$(basename -- "$entry")"
    if [[ -e "$dest/$name" || -L "$dest/$name" ]]; then
      echo "ERROR: init não sobrescreve '$dest/$name'; remova ou mova o item conflitante e tente novamente" >&2
      exit 2
    fi
  done
  cp -a -- "$template/." "$dest/"
  echo "Projeto CAD3D inicializado em: $dest"
  exit 0
fi

if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
  usage >&2
  exit 2
fi
run_orca() {
  local operation="$1"
  shift
  if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo 'ERROR: Docker Engine e o plugin Docker Compose precisam estar disponíveis para executar o motor Orca isolado.' >&2
    exit 125
  fi
  export CAD3D_PROJECT="$(pwd -P)"
  export CAD3D_UID="$(id -u)"
  export CAD3D_GID="$(id -g)"
  local image="cad3d-orca:2.4.2"
  if [[ "$operation" == "build" ]]; then
    exec docker compose -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" build orca
  fi
  if ! docker image inspect "$image" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: imagem $image indisponível. Construa-a com: cad3d slicer build" >&2
    exit 125
  fi
  exec docker compose -f "$COMPOSE_FILE" run --rm --no-deps --user "$CAD3D_UID:$CAD3D_GID" orca "$operation" "$@"

    *) echo 'usage: cad3d slicer {build|doctor}' >&2; exit 2 ;;

  exit 2
fi

  exit 127
fi
if ! docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'ERROR: Docker Compose plugin não está disponível (`docker compose`).' >&2
  exit 127
fi
if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'ERROR: Docker Engine indisponível ou sem permissão para este usuário.' >&2
  exit 125
fi
if ! docker image inspect "$IMAGE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ERROR: imagem $IMAGE não encontrada. Construa-a uma vez com: docker compose -f '$COMPOSE_FILE' build" >&2
  exit 125
fi

export CAD3D_PROJECT="$(pwd -P)"
export CAD3D_UID="$(id -u)"

def validate_architecture(project_root: Path, *, shapes=None, placed_shapes=None):
    """Validate `.cad3d/engineering.yaml` structure and CAD-linked evidence."""
    root = Path(project_root).resolve()
    contract_path = root / ".cad3d/engineering.yaml"
    if not contract_path.is_file():
        return {"status": "NOT_EVALUATED", "reason": "engineering_contract_missing",
                "contract": str(contract_path), "phases": {}, "checks": []}
    contract = _read_yaml(contract_path)
    eng = contract.get("engineering", {})
    project = eng.get("project", {})
    level = eng.get("workflow_level", "product")
    checks = []
    expected_project = ("name", "class", "purpose", "units")
    missing = [field for field in expected_project if not project.get(field) or
               str(project.get(field)).strip().lower() in ("todo", "tbd", "unknown")]
    _check(checks, "project-identity", "Identidade e propósito do produto",
           "FAIL" if missing else "PASS", detail={"missing": missing}, severity="critical",
           recommendation="Defina nome, classe, função do produto e unidades explícitas.")

    reqs = eng.get("requirements", []) or []
    subsystems = (eng.get("functional_architecture", {}) or {}).get("subsystems", []) or []
    components = (eng.get("mechanical_architecture", {}) or {}).get("components", []) or []
    interfaces = (eng.get("mechanical_architecture", {}) or {}).get("interfaces", []) or []
    req_ids = _unique(reqs, "id", "requirements", checks)
    subsystem_ids = _unique(subsystems, "id", "subsystems", checks)
    component_ids = _unique(components, "id", "components", checks)
    interface_ids = _unique(interfaces, "id", "interfaces", checks)
    assembly_path = root / ".cad3d/assembly.yaml"
    assembly = _read_yaml(assembly_path) if assembly_path.is_file() else {}
    assembly_components = {str(item.get("id")): item for item in assembly.get("components", [])}
    assembly_pairs = {frozenset((str(item.get("a")), str(item.get("b")))): item
                      for item in assembly.get("interfaces", [])}

    phase_checks = {"requirements": [], "functional_architecture": [], "mechanical_architecture": [],
                    "modeling": [], "system_verification": [], "manufacturing": []}
    for field in ("operating_conditions", "measurements", "external_interfaces",
                  "acceptance_criteria", "risks_and_unknowns"):
        value = eng.get(field, [])
        minimum = 1 if level == "product" else (0 if field in ("operating_conditions", "risks_and_unknowns") else 1)
        ok = bool(value) and isinstance(value, list) if minimum else isinstance(value, list)
        _check(phase_checks["requirements"], f"requirements-{field}", field.replace("_", " ").title(),
               "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", detail={"item_count": len(value) if isinstance(value, list) else 0},
               severity="critical", recommendation=f"Registre {field.replace('_', ' ')} antes de fechar a arquitetura.")
    measurements = eng.get("measurements", []) or []
    unclassified_measurements = [m.get("id", "<missing-id>") for m in measurements
        if m.get("confidence") not in ("verified", "assumption") or
        (m.get("confidence") == "verified" and not m.get("source")) or
        (m.get("confidence") == "assumption" and not m.get("uncertainty"))]
    _check(phase_checks["requirements"], "measurement-evidence", "Medições separadas de hipóteses",
           "FAIL" if unclassified_measurements else ("PASS" if measurements else "NOT_EVALUATED"),
           detail={"unclassified": unclassified_measurements}, severity="critical",
           recommendation="Classifique cada medida como verified com source, ou assumption com uncertainty.")
    empty_criteria = [x.get("id", "<missing-id>") for x in eng.get("acceptance_criteria", []) or []
                      if not x.get("method") or not x.get("threshold")]
    _check(phase_checks["requirements"], "acceptance-criteria-defined", "Critérios de aceitação mensuráveis",
           "FAIL" if empty_criteria else ("PASS" if eng.get("acceptance_criteria") else "NOT_EVALUATED"),
           detail={"incomplete": empty_criteria}, severity="critical",
           recommendation="Defina método de verificação e limiar observável para cada critério.")
    _check(checks, "requirements-phase", "Fase 1: requisitos", _status(phase_checks["requirements"]),
           detail=phase_checks["requirements"], severity="critical")

    min_subsystems = 1 if level == "lightweight" else 2
    _check(phase_checks["functional_architecture"], "functional-subsystems", "Subsistemas com função",
           "WARNING" if len(subsystems) >= min_subsystems and all(x.get("purpose") for x in subsystems) else "FAIL",
           detail={"count": len(subsystems), "minimum": min_subsystems}, severity="critical",
           kind="engineering_judgment",
           recommendation="Revise se as funções declaradas cobrem conceitualmente a operação; presença de campos não comprova funcionamento.")
    flows = (eng.get("functional_architecture", {}) or {}).get("flows", []) or []
    flow_ids = _unique(flows, "id", "flows", phase_checks["functional_architecture"])
    for flow in flows:
        route = flow.get("path", [])
        known_nodes = subsystem_ids | component_ids
        unknown = [str(node) for node in route if str(node) not in known_nodes]
        status = "WARNING" if len(route) >= 2 and not unknown else "FAIL"
        _check(phase_checks["functional_architecture"], f"flow-{flow.get('id')}",
               f"Fluxo funcional {flow.get('id')}", status,
               detail={"path": route, "unknown_nodes": unknown,
                       "evidence_limit": "declared topology only; conceptual operation needs engineering review"},
               severity="critical", kind="engineering_judgment",
               recommendation="Verifique se portas, estados e transições formam uma sequência funcional real.")
    fa = eng.get("functional_architecture", {}) or {}
    for key in ("operating_modes", "failure_modes"):
        ok = bool(fa.get(key))
        _check(phase_checks["functional_architecture"], f"functional-{key}", key.replace("_", " ").title(),
               ("WARNING" if ok else "FAIL"), detail={"item_count": len(fa.get(key, []) or []),
               "evidence_limit": "declared cases require engineering review"},
               severity="critical", kind="engineering_judgment",
               recommendation=f"Revise a cobertura e plausibilidade de {key.replace('_', ' ')}; a lista não comprova comportamento.")
    _check(checks, "functional-architecture-phase", "Fase 2: arquitetura funcional",
           _status(phase_checks["functional_architecture"]), detail=phase_checks["functional_architecture"], severity="critical")

    if not assembly_components and components:
        _check(phase_checks["mechanical_architecture"], "assembly-manifest", "Instâncias CAD de montagem",
               "FAIL", severity="critical", recommendation="Declare as instâncias posicionadas em .cad3d/assembly.yaml.")
    for comp in components:
        ident = str(comp.get("id"))
        retention = comp.get("retention") or {}
        method = retention.get("method")
        evidence = {"assembly_component": assembly_components.get(ident),
                    "part": comp.get("part"), "function": comp.get("function"),
                    "retention": retention}
        if ident not in assembly_components:
            st = "FAIL"; reason = "component_not_present_in_cad_assembly"
        elif not comp.get("part") or not comp.get("function"):
            st = "FAIL"; reason = "part_or_function_missing"
        elif not method:
            st = "FAIL"; reason = "retention_method_missing"
        elif method not in RETENTION_METHODS:
            st = "FAIL"; reason = "unknown_retention_method"
        elif method == "intentional_free":
            st = "PASS" if retention.get("reason") else "FAIL"
            reason = "intentional_free_documented" if st == "PASS" else "intentional_free_requires_reason"
        elif method == "monolithic":
            solid_count = len((shapes or {}).get(comp.get("part"), []).solids()) if shapes and comp.get("part") in shapes else None
            st = "PASS" if solid_count == 1 else ("WARNING" if solid_count is None else "FAIL")
            reason = "single_connected_brep" if st == "PASS" else ("single-body verification deferred until CAD build" if st == "WARNING" else "monolithic_solid_not_proven")
        elif method == "fixed_to_datum":
            st = "WARNING" if retention.get("datum") and retention.get("fastener_interface") else "FAIL"
            reason = "external_fixing_interface_declared_but_load_not_analyzed" if st == "WARNING" else "datum_or_fixing_interface_missing"
        else:
            referenced = retention.get("interface_ids", []) or []
            missing_refs = [x for x in referenced if x not in interface_ids]
            connected = [i for i in interfaces if i.get("id") in referenced and ident in (i.get("components") or [])]
            pair_refs = [i for i in connected if len(i.get("components", [])) == 2 and
                         frozenset(map(str, i["components"])) in assembly_pairs]
            if not referenced or missing_refs or not connected or len(pair_refs) != len(connected):
                st = "FAIL"; reason = "retention_has_no_complete_positioned_interface"
            else:
                st = "WARNING"; reason = "retention_geometry_declared; load_or_capture_strength_not_proven"
        _check(phase_checks["mechanical_architecture"], f"retention-{ident}",
               f"Retenção de {ident}", st, evidence={"component": evidence, "reason": reason},
               severity="critical" if st == "FAIL" else "major",

"""Machine-readable product engineering contracts and evidence-based reviews.

This module checks traceability and CAD evidence. It deliberately does not
pretend that a complete YAML file proves function, retention strength, flow,
printability, or physical performance.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

STATES = {"PASS", "FAIL", "WARNING", "NOT_EVALUATED"}
RETENTION_METHODS = {
    "monolithic", "fastener", "snap_fit", "captured_rail", "dovetail",
    "press_fit", "gravity_seat", "gravity_seat_and_sliding_clearance",
    "gravity_seat_sliding_fit", "adhesive", "clamp", "intentional_free",
    "fixed_to_datum", "other",
}


def _read_yaml(path):
    import yaml
    return yaml.safe_load(Path(path).read_text()) or {}


def _status(checks):
    states = [x["status"] for x in checks]
    if "FAIL" in states:
        return "FAIL"
    if "WARNING" in states:
        return "WARNING"
    if "NOT_EVALUATED" in states:
        return "NOT_EVALUATED"
    return "PASS"


def _check(checks, ident, title, status, *, evidence=None, detail=None,
           severity="major", kind="automated", recommendation=None):
    checks.append({"id": ident, "title": title, "status": status,
                   "severity": severity, "kind": kind, "evidence": evidence,
                   "detail": detail, "recommendation": recommendation})


def _get_pointer(value, pointer):
    if pointer in ("", "/"):
        return value
    current = value
    for token in pointer.lstrip("/").split("/"):
        token = token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
        if isinstance(current, list):
            current = current[int(token)]
        else:
            current = current[token]
    return current


def _evidence_result(project_root, evidence):
    """Return an observed JSON value; never trust a status written in YAML."""
    path = Path(evidence.get("path", ""))
    if path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts:
        raise ValueError("evidence paths must be project-relative and cannot escape the project")
    full = project_root / path
    if not full.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(str(path))
    payload = json.loads(full.read_text())
    observed = _get_pointer(payload, evidence.get("json_pointer", ""))
    digest = hashlib.sha256(full.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return observed, {"path": path.as_posix(), "json_pointer": evidence.get("json_pointer", ""),
                     "observed": observed, "sha256": digest}


def _unique(items, key, label, checks):
    ids = [str(item.get(key, "")) for item in items if isinstance(item, dict)]
    dup = sorted({value for value in ids if not value or ids.count(value) > 1})
    _check(checks, f"unique-{label}", f"IDs únicos: {label}",
           "FAIL" if dup else "PASS", detail={"invalid_or_duplicate_ids": dup},
           severity="critical", recommendation=f"Declare IDs não vazios e únicos em {label}.")
    return set(ids)


def validate_architecture(project_root: Path, *, shapes=None, placed_shapes=None):
    """Validate `.cad3d/engineering.yaml` structure and CAD-linked evidence."""
    root = Path(project_root).resolve()
    contract_path = root / ".cad3d/engineering.yaml"
    if not contract_path.is_file():

    contract = _read_yaml(contract_path)

    interface_ids = _unique(interfaces, "id", "interfaces", checks)

item.text: A verificação amostral já confirmou continuidade geométrica da rota entre bocais, atravessando as três câmaras: 810 amostras, raio livre declarado de 6 mm e nenhuma obstrução detectada. Isso é evidência de espaço aberto no CAD, não de vazão ou purga eficaz. Estou corrigindo agora a montagem: a tampa precisa de folga/posicionamento coerente com o corpo, e o relatório de validação indicou uma falha nessa interface.

"""Módulo passivo de três câmaras, tampa removível e bocais acessíveis.

As dimensões dos bocais e folgas de vedação são provisórias até conhecer
mangueira, junta, material e processo de fabricação.
"""
from build123d import Align, Box, Cylinder, Pos, Rot


def build(params):
    p = params["module"]
    L, W, H = p["length"], p["width"], p["height"]
    wall, floor = p["wall"], p["floor"]
    port_d, port_len = p["port_diameter"], p["port_length"]
    chamber_len = (L - 2 * wall - 2 * p["baffle_thickness"]) / 3
    if min(L, W, H, wall, floor, port_d, port_len) <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Todos os parâmetros dimensionais precisam ser positivos")
    if L > 160 or W > 100 or H > 90:
        raise ValueError("Envelope máximo permitido: 160 x 100 x 90 mm")
    if 2 * wall >= W or floor >= H or port_d >= W - 2 * wall:
        raise ValueError("Dimensões incompatíveis com paredes/câmaras")

    # Corpo oco aberto por cima; fundo e paredes unidos como um único sólido.
    outer = Box(L, W, H, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
    cavity = Pos(wall, wall, floor) * Box(
        L - 2 * wall, W - 2 * wall, H,
        align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN),
    )
    body = outer - cavity

    # Duas divisórias transversais, cada uma com vão inferior amplo para transferência.
    t = p["baffle_thickness"]
    gap_w, gap_h = p["transfer_width"], p["transfer_height"]
    for x in (wall + chamber_len, wall + chamber_len + t + chamber_len):
        baffle = Pos(x, wall, floor) * Box(t, W - 2 * wall, H - floor - wall,
                                            align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
        opening = Pos(x - 0.1, (W - gap_w) / 2, floor - 0.01) * Box(
            t + 0.2, gap_w, gap_h, align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN)
        )
        body += baffle - opening

    # Bocais coaxiais com a passagem, em lados opostos e acessíveis.
    zc, yc = p["port_z"], W / 2
    inlet = Pos(-port_len, yc, zc) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(
        port_d / 2, port_len, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    outlet = Pos(L, yc, zc) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(
        port_d / 2, port_len, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    # Cut the port bores through walls and stubs; axes run along X.
    bore_len = L + 2 * port_len + 2
    bore = Pos(-port_len - 1, yc, zc) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(
        port_d / 2, bore_len, align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN))
    body = body + inlet + outlet - bore

    # Tampa plana removível com três furos de enchimento/purga sobre câmaras.
    lid_t = p["cover_thickness"]
    cover = Pos(0, 0, H) * Box(L, W, lid_t,
        align=(Align.MIN, Align.MIN, Align.MIN))
    vent_d = p["vent_diameter"]
    for cx in (L / 6, L / 2, 5 * L / 6):
        hole = Pos(cx, W / 2, H + lid_t / 2) * Cylinder(vent_d / 2, lid_t + 0.2,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER))
        cover -= hole
    return {"body": body, "cover": cover}

def init(args):
    dest=Path(args.project).resolve()
    if dest.exists(): raise FileExistsError(f'{dest} já existe; não será sobrescrito')
    shutil.copytree('/opt/cad3d/template',dest); print(f'Projeto criado: {dest}')

def write_manifest():
    cfg, params, shapes, out = project_files()
    model_path = Path(cfg['model'])
    parameter_path = Path('.cad3d') / cfg.get('parameters', 'params.yaml')
    artifacts = []
    for path in sorted(out.iterdir()):
        if path.is_file() and path.name != 'manifest.json':
            artifacts.append({'path':path.name,'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
    assembly_path=Path('.cad3d/assembly.yaml')
    contract_path=Path('.cad3d/engineering.yaml')
    manifest={'project':cfg['name'],'units':'mm','engine':'build123d 0.11.1 / OCP 7.9','source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(model_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'parameters_sha256':hashlib.sha256(parameter_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'assembly_sha256':hashlib.sha256(assembly_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if assembly_path.exists() else None,'engineering_sha256':hashlib.sha256(contract_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if contract_path.exists() else None,'artifacts':artifacts}

    print(f'PASS: manifesto {out}/manifest.json')

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(prog='cad3d',description='CAD paramétrico e DfAM em container')
    sub=p.add_subparsers(dest='command',required=True)
    for name,fn in [('doctor',doctor),('build',build),('validate',validate),('render',render),('export',export),('report',report),('test',test)]:
        q=sub.add_parser(name)
        if name in ('validate','render'): q.add_argument('--assembly',help='YAML de montagem; por padrão .cad3d/assembly.yaml')
        if name=='render':
            q.add_argument('--view',choices=('preview','iso','top','front','side','section','exploded','hidden','interfaces','engineering'))
            q.add_argument('--section-axis',choices=('x','y','z'),default='x')
            q.add_argument('--section-at',type=float)
            q.add_argument('--hide',action='append',help='IDs de componente a ocultar; pode repetir ou separar por vírgula')
            q.add_argument('--interface',help='ID de interface para destacar')
            q.add_argument('--explode-mm',type=float)
        if name=='report': q.add_argument('--requirements',action='store_true',help='incorpora design-review.json')
        q.set_defaults(func=fn)
    q=sub.add_parser('architecture',help='validar contrato e sequência das fases de engenharia')
    aq=q.add_subparsers(dest='architecture_action',required=True)
    ai=aq.add_parser('init');ai.add_argument('--level',choices=('lightweight','product'),default='product');ai.set_defaults(func=architecture_init)
    av=aq.add_parser('validate');av.add_argument('--geometry',action='store_true',help='também amostra percursos declarados na geometria B-rep');av.set_defaults(func=architecture_validate)
    q=sub.add_parser('review',help='revisão automática de traceabilidade e evidências de engenharia')
    q.set_defaults(func=product_review)
    q=sub.add_parser('init'); q.add_argument('project'); q.set_defaults(func=init)
    q=sub.add_parser('calibration',help='gerar cupons ou registrar medições dimensionais')
    cal=q.add_subparsers(dest='action',required=True)
    gen=cal.add_parser('generate'); gen.add_argument('--config'); gen.add_argument('--output'); gen.set_defaults(func=calibration)
    rec=cal.add_parser('record'); rec.add_argument('record'); rec.set_defaults(func=calibration)

item.text: Encontrei a causa da ausência de saliência: o furo passante tinha o mesmo diâmetro que os bocais, removendo toda a parede dos tubos. Vou corrigir para bocais curtos com diâmetro externo de 22 mm e furo de 16 mm. Isso cria uma conexão física acessível; como a mangueira não foi especificada, retenção por farpa/abraçadeira e ajuste continuam pendentes.

item.text:
## Projeto concluído

Escolhi três câmaras em série, com transferências inferiores, tampa removível e portas superiores para purga. A comparação de alternativas e os motivos da escolha estão em [ARCHITECTURE.md](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/C-circulation/ARCHITECTURE.md).

O envelope nominal do conjunto é **160 × 78 × 58 mm**, dentro do limite. Os bocais têm **22 mm externos, 16 mm internos e 18 mm de projeção**. O modelo paramétrico está em [src/model.py](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/C-circulation/src/model.py), com parâmetros em [.cad3d/params.yaml](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/C-circulation/.cad3d/params.yaml).

A rota entre entrada e saída passou na verificação geométrica amostrada: **810 pontos**, espaçamento de 2 mm e raio livre declarado de 6 mm, sem bloqueios detectados. Isso verifica espaço no CAD; **não mede vazão nem perda de carga e não é CFD**.

O relatório completo está em [RELATORIO.md](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/C-circulation/RELATORIO.md). O CAD gerou arquivos [STEP do corpo](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/C-circulation/build/outputs/body.step) e [da tampa](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/C-circulation/build/outputs/cover.step), além de vistas como a [seção longitudinal](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/C-circulation/build/outputs/E_section.png) e o [corpo com a tampa oculta](/tmp/cad3d-v141-eval/baseline/C-circulation/build/outputs/G_hidden_components.png).

**Limites atuais:** a validação CAD geral ficou em `FAIL` porque a trajetória de remoção da tampa não foi avaliada; a revisão de arquitetura ficou em `WARNING`. Mangueiras, fixação e vedação da tampa e tampões para as três portas de purga ainda precisam ser especificados. Vazão, estanqueidade, purga de ar e facilidade de limpeza exigem ensaio físico.
